sentences.text: The crime pertaining to the said case was registered pursuant to Ext.P1 private complaint filed by the 5 th respondent.
There are three accused.

The offences alleged against the petitioner and the remaining accused are punishable under Sections 120B, 406, 409, 468, 471,
477A, 420 r/w 34 of IPC.

The allegation is that the petitioner being the office bearer of a trust namely Imam Razi Muslim Educational Charitable Trust, Kamaliya Medical Institution, Mala,
siphoned off crores of rupees from the trust fund and spent huge amounts for his own personal Khalid Haji vs State Of Kerala on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/14476467/

sentences.text: There were civil disputes also between the parties.
All disputes between the parties were amicably settled in the Lok Adalath as per Ext.P4 award.
In the award, it is specifically stated that the 5 th respondent would withdraw C.C.No.91 of 2005 by filing a compounding petition.
According to the petitioner, after Ext.P4 award, the 5th respondent failed to comply with the condition in WP(C) NO.41055 OF 2018 2025:KER:20953 Ext.P4 award that he would withdraw the case.
It is in these circumstances, the petitioner has approached this Court.
2. I have heard Sri.P.Haridas, the learned counsel for the petitioner, Sri.K.A.Salil Narayanan, the learned counsel for the 5th respondent and Smt.Sreeja V., the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.

3. Clauses 5 & 6 of Ext.P4 award reads as follows:-
"5. All disputes between the parties herein and original 18 trustees of Imam Razi Muslim Medical Educational and charitable trust have been settled finally.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Parties in the suit and other trustees shall take all efforts to see that C.C. 91/05 filed on a complaint made by X.M.A. Rahim and others are also settled and the above said criminal case is stand legally closed.
Complainant will take steps to compound the offence or withdraw the said calendar case.
Like wise K.M.A. Rahim shall take necessary steps to close a crime registered in the Mala police station against Khalid Haji and others at the earliest.

The Believers Church shall take steps to compound or withdrew C.C. 2129/02 now pending before the Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Ernakulam C.C.967/07 filed on the basis of complaint filed by N.K.Abdul Karim, brother of .
.Hassan, pending in Chalakudy Magistrate Court will be closed legally.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Ernakulam C.C.967/07
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. All criminal and civil matters, will be settled /compounded /withdrawn.
all disputes which has WP(C) NO.41055 OF 2018 2025:KER:20953 arisen in connection with the trust of running of the above said trust will stand settled."
4. The petitioner and the 5th respondent are parties to Ext.P4.
It has become final.
Since all the parties to the award are bound by the terms of Ext.P4 award, they are bound to comply with its terms.
The 5th respondent is bound to take steps to withdraw the complaint by filing a compounding petition, which he failed.
This Court, in a similar situation, quashed the proceedings against the 3rd accused vide Ext.P6 order on the ground of settlement.
For the reasons stated above, I am of the view that no purpose will be served in proceeding with criminal prosecution in C.C.No.91 of 2005 against the petitioner.
Accordingly, all the proceedings against the petitioner in C.C.No.91 of 2005 is hereby quashed.
This writ petition is allowed.
